title: pkg/registry/apps/ — control flow map (App-SDK AppInstaller wiring)
answers: How does an App-SDK app get installed into Grafana's API server?
Where is AppInstaller wired for playlist/shorturl/notifications/etc?
How do legacy DB-backed services bridge to the new k8s API apps?
body:
Each subpackage of pkg/registry/apps (playlist, shorturl, annotation, alerting/notifications, advisor, quotas, example, ...) implements `appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller` for one App-SDK app defined in `apps/<name>/`. Control flow:
1. `<pkg>/register.go` defines `AppInstaller` (embeds `appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller`), overrides `GetAuthorizer()`, and a `RegisterApp(...)`-style constructor wrapping the app's own `simple.App`/`appsdkapiserver` builder with Grafana-specific cfg/featuremgmt/accesscontrol.
2. `pkg/registry/apps/wireset.go` (`appregistry.WireSet`) lists every subpackage's installer provider for `wire`.
3. `pkg/registry/apps/apps.go:ProvideAppInstallers` takes one constructed installer arg per app (feature-toggle gated — some apps are conditionally included based on `featuremgmt`) and returns `[]appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller`.
4. Consumed by `pkg/services/apiserver/service.go` (field `appInstallers`), which calls `appinstaller.AddToScheme`, `appinstaller.RegisterAuthorizers`, `appinstaller.NewAPIResourceConfig`, `appinstaller.BuildOpenAPIDefGetter` — see `pkg/services/apiserver/appinstaller/installer.go` and its README for the full framework (schema registration, admission plugins, OpenAPI, lifecycle).
Apps that need to read/write the legacy SQL-backed store alongside the new k8s resource follow a 3-4 file split per subpackage: `type.go` (ResourceInfo via `utils.NewResourceInfo`), `legacy_storage.go` or `storage.go` (`rest.Storage` implementation wrapping the legacy service, e.g. shorturl/legacy_storage.go, receiver/storage.go+receiver/legacy_storage.go), `conversions.go` (legacy model <-> unstructured/k8s object, e.g. playlist/conversions.go), and optionally `migration_registrar.go` (registers a `migrations.MigrationDefinition` with `pkg/storage/unified/migrations` for one-time DB->resource migration, e.g. shorturl/migration_registrar.go). RBAC fixed-role grants for an app's resources live in `<pkg>/accesscontrol.go` (`FixedRoleRegistrations()`), separate from the authorizer logic in register.go.

search: App-SDK AppInstaller registration: each subpackage in pkg/registry/apps/ implements appsdkapiserver.AppInstaller via register.go, which overrides GetAuthorizer() and wraps the app's builder with Grafana cfg/featuremgmt/accesscontrol. Control flow: subpackage providers → wireset.go WireSet → ProvideAppInstallers (feature-toggle gated) → apiserver service. Apps with legacy SQL stores require parallel 3–4-file split: type.go (ResourceInfo), legacy_storage.go/storage.go (rest.Storage wrapper), conversions.go (model ↔ unstructured), and optional migration_registrar.go (migrations.MigrationDefinition). RBAC FixedRoleRegistrations() lives in accesscontrol.go separate from authorizer logic. Applies when: adding new App-SDK apps, integrating legacy storage, or wiring authorization per subpackage.
